# Vendored front-end libraries (served locally, no CDN, no build step)

| Library | Version | License | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com) | 5.3.3 | MIT | layout, components (navbar, cards, pagination, accordion, modal, forms) |
| [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com) | 1.11.3 | MIT | icon font |
| [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) via [@fontsource-variable/inter](https://fontsource.org) | 5.1.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | typeface (latin + latin-ext, variable weight) |

Updating: replace the files from the jsDelivr paths of the same packages and keep the directory layout
(`bootstrap-icons.min.css` expects `fonts/` next to it).
